report.title: BazarCall to Conti Ransomware via Trickbot and Cobalt Strike

timelineNote: The report's two-day chronology is preserved: Cobalt hands-on at two hours, two-endpoint movement fifteen minutes after enumeration, service-loader execution ten minutes later after eight attempts, DC pivot near four hours, return two days later, and Conti deployment in under thirty minutes. DC paths and impact files are generated canaries only; real DC execution is refused.

phases.name: BazarCall XLSB, renamed CertUtil, Regsvr32, Trickbot wermgr/svchost injection and pwgrab, PowerShell Cobalt, and redundant C2
Native/AdFind/BloodHound/PowerSploit discovery, WMIC movement, service retries, Defender/LSASS/GetSystem, DC pivot, ntdsutil, and exfil markers
Two-day return, generated DC share staging, _COPY/_EXE PsExec fan-out, Conti fQumH, KCRAO files, and readme markers
